recommended_formula.description: For each semantic component choose a relative total engineering-effort weight, independently of file/function/LOC count. For each proof stage assign a bounded completion judgment using actual scope evidence. Overall=sum(component_weight * stage_weight * bounded_stage_score). Shared ABI/library work belongs to one owning component; other rows include only incremental consumer work.
recommended_formula.judgment_basis: Lifecycle/address-space/syscall algorithms, hardware callback ordering, shared ABI integration and changed-cohort validation dominate remaining effort. Small accessor wrappers and source-only scaffolds receive less weight. All weights are planning assumptions, not measured time.
recommended_formula.unknown_handling: Unassessed is an interval with explicit unresolved work, never zero implementation. Missing delivery/optional ownership is a denominator risk and widens range; it cannot silently count as complete.
recommended_formula.baseline_handling: Existing Rust and reviewed assembly deserve implementation and scoped test/link/native credit where the evidence matches. Remaining six/eight C files describe residual ownership, not the entire amount of engineering already done.
